title: A scroll-hold test checks where cards sit on screen, not scrollY
why: A test that asserts window.scrollY stays the same can pass while cards still jump on screen.
note: Lane page-lane-answered-sinks, 16:59 CST Nov 6. Its test brief asserted that scrollY stays unchanged, but the outcome to protect is that cards hold their place on screen. That cost a builder round on PR #1373. Proposed check: the test-author agent file, or a lint on page.test.mjs, flags a scroll-hold case that asserts scrollY equality without checking viewport positions.
